 3 die of dengue, 1,674 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 516 this year 
 Published : 21 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 21 November 2026, 18:42
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least three dengue patients died and 1,674 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, two were reported in Dhaka division and one in Khulna division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the total death toll this year has risen to 516 while the cumulative number of cases reached 171,954.
 Currently, 5,574 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
